message.content: {"ranking": [], "explanation": "All candidates are condition_gate or state_retention edits on the same small combinational block. The observed failure is frame_len=3 vs expected 1 at cycle 5 (port frame_len). The bit-count loop at lines 97-101 iterates i=0..KEEP_WIDTH and assigns bit_cnt=i on each mask match, keeping the last (largest) match; for contiguous low-order masks this yields the popcount, but the loop range and assignment style are functionally correct for the supported masks. None of the offered patches modify the popcount logic (line 98 equality), the loop bound (line 97), the accumulation (line 102), or the frame_len_reg reset/initialization. The condition_gate patches only add unrelated qualifiers (rst, frame_reg, monitor_axis_tlast, etc.) that do not change the counted value for the failing transfer. The state_retention patches (1bf21575a3be, 5e3af25f023e) affect frame_len_valid_next defaulting, not frame_len_next. Since no candidate touches the actual length calculation, none can close the frame_len mismatch; ranking them would imply a false mechanism. Therefore the ranking is empty."}
